jobs.occupation: Animal Health Sales Director - Veterinary - Pharma
jobs.description:
Our client is a Belgian company specialising in the development, registration, marketing and commercialisation of veterinary pharmaceutical products for both livestock and companion animal. The organisation has built a strong reputation through its scientific expertise, in-house R&D laboratory, and regulatory excellence. Operating internationally through a network of manufacturing and distribution partners, the company offers innovative veterinary solutions across multiple continents while maintaining the agility, ownership culture, and entrepreneurial spirit of a growing SME.

Jobomschrijving

As a successful Animal Health Sales Manager - Pharmaceutical Products - Veterinary channel, you will have the following responsibilities: 

Business Development - Creation of new partnerships

• Identify new business opportunities and evaluate new potential products for the portfolio.
• Conduct market analysis to identify unmet needs within the Belgian veterinary sector.
• Assess partnerships with pharmaceutical manufacturers and negotiate exclusive distribution opportunities.
• Define product positioning, pricing strategies, and go-to-market plans.
• Prepare and support product launches in collaboration with the sales team.

Field Sales Management 

• Develop and execute the commercial strategy for the Belgian market.
• Lead, motivate, and coach a team of 5 sales representatives covering Belgium.
• Maintain close contact with key stakeholders in the Belgian veterinary market.
• Monitor market trends, competition, and business performance.

As a successful Animal Health Sales Manager - Pharmaceutical Products - Veterinary channel, you will have the following profile:

• Veterinary degree or equivalent in-depth expertise and network within the veterinary industry.
• 10/15 years of experiences in the Animal Health industry.
• Strong knowledge of the Belgian veterinary market and its key stakeholders.
• Proven experience in a commercial, sales management, or business development role.
• Previous experience managing and coaching sales teams.
• Strategic mindset combined with a hands-on approach.
• Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
• Fluent in Dutch with a good level of English.

FMCG

Jobomschrijving

• Create and maintain production plans
• Ensure products are available for customer orders and stock
• Monitor production constraints daily and adjust schedules when needed
• Support projects related to new product launches, phase-outs, and process improvements
• Work with different teams to coordinate product launches and discontinuations
• Represent the planning team in internal meetings
• Keep planning data and systems up to date
• Communicate with planning, production, purchasing, and customer service teams to solve planning challenges

• Great communication skills in Dutch, English and French
• Related bachelor or master 
• Stress resistant and assertive
• Experience in Production Planning 
• Experience within FMCG is a big plus
• Good SAP knowledge

About the role   You will provide administrative and logistical support to our association management teams  to deliver high-quality services and value to our clients. In coordinating and communicating with our volunteer groups and committees, you will also support our associations’ mission and activities.
 

Duties and Responsibilities   

 
• bull;    Schedule meetings, prepare agendas, reports, and presentations for board, committee and working party meetings. Coordinate with all attendees. 
 
• bull;    Facilitate meetings, capturing action items and decisions. Manage post-meeting activities such as distributing minutes, tracking all action items and following up on outstanding items. 
 
• bull;    Provide administrative support, including scheduling, travel arrangements, and expense management. 
 
• bull;    Support with managing administration for corporate partnership deals and sponsorship agreements. 
 
• bull;    Track and manage the administration of grants and awards for a health care association. 
 
• bull;    Maintain governance documents, policies, and other relevant materials in a centralised repository. 
 
• bull;    Assist with the planning and execution of association events, programs, and projects. 
 
• bull;    Liaise with volunteer groups and committees and provide them with guidance, resources, and feedback. 
 
• bull;    Handle inquiries from members, partners, and the public and direct them to the appropriate person or department. 
 
• bull;    Organise and maintain files, records, and databases. 
 

Your profile   Eligible to work in the EU. At least three years’ experience in an administrative or support role, preferably in a non-profit or association setting. Fluent in English (verbal and written level C1), Knowledge of another language is an asset. Proficient in the Microsoft Office package, Google Suite, and other web-based tools. Ability to work independently and collaboratively with a diverse team. Strong organizational, time management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to prioritise and multitask. You are flexible, agile and committed especially in busy periods. Knowledge of and interest in the association's field and mission. Willingness to travel abroad for certain meetings and events. Available to join the team rapidly.

Our client is a globally recognised industrial manufacturing organisation operating in high-performance process industries. With more than 10,000 employees worldwide and a strong international footprint across multiple continents, the company combines global expertise with local manufacturing excellence. The Belgian production site offers a family-oriented working environment where employees are given significant responsibility and opportunities for growth.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage demand planning, production scheduling and inventory levels for raw materials and semi-finished goods
• Translate sales requirements and production capacity into effective production plans and MRP requirements
• Monitor stock levels, warehouse capacity and material availability while proactively resolving supply bottlenecks
• Analyse supply chain performance through KPIs, reporting and management information
• Coordinate logistics activities, intercompany shipments and international supply flows
• Develop strong relationships with suppliers, logistics providers and internal stakeholders to ensure service excellence
• Lead and coach a team of three direct reports while driving continuous improvement and standardisation initiatives

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Logistics or a related discipline
• Minimum 5 years of experience in Supply Chain, Demand Planning, Production Planning or Logistics within an industrial environment
• Proven experience working with international stakeholders and global supply chain networks
• Strong knowledge of ERP systems (SAP preferred), Supply Chain tools and advanced Excel
• Analytical problem solver with a proactive and hands-on mindset
• Fluent in English and a conversational level in Dutch is required
• Able to work independently while effectively managing multiple priorities in a dynamic manufacturing environment

jobs.occupation: Legal Counsel - Commercial & Consumer Law - Limburg
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international leisure and hospitality group headquartered in Europe, operating multiple business units across several countries. The Belgian organization employs approximately 2,000 people across different sites and operates within a highly decentralized structure, allowing local entities to maintain significant autonomy while benefiting from the support of a large international group.

Jobomschrijving

As a Legal Counsel your responsibilities are:

• Provide pragmatic and business-oriented legal advice to senior management and operational teams.
• Draft, review, negotiate, and manage a variety of commercial contracts.
• Advise on agency, distribution, procurement, and service agreements.
• Support construction and real estate projects, including related contractual negotiations.
• Monitor and advise on consumer law matters impacting the Belgian business.
• Contribute to ESG-related projects and provide legal support regarding evolving sustainability regulations.
• Identify legal risks and develop practical mitigation strategies.
• Strengthen compliance frameworks and internal governance procedures.
• Collaborate closely with departments such as Procurement, Marketing, Communications, and Operations.
• Translate complex legal concepts into pragmatic solutions that facilitate business growth.

A successful Legal Counsel should have:

• Master's degree in Law obtained from a Belgian university.
• Minimum 3 years of relevant legal experience as legal counsel or lawyer
• Fluent in English, ideally in Dutch as well (or conversational level)
• Strong expertise in: Commercial contracts, Consumer law, Real estate and construction law
• Exposure to ESG-related matters is considered a strong asset.
• Comfortable working independently and managing a broad legal scope.

• You combine strong analytical capabilities with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset 
• You are able to work independently, while also being an effective and collaborative team player.

As a production worker, you're the driving force behind the production process. You ensure the production line always runs smoothly by replenishing and trimming meat as needed. Don't worry if you don't have experience with knives – you'll learn! You'll also help load and unload trucks and work in various departments, such as production, packaging, and shipping. No two days are the same for a production worker, and that's what makes it so rewarding.
We're looking for a production worker who's a hands-on person.

You're physically fit, speak fluent Dutch or English, and enjoy working independently and as part of a team. As a production worker, you take responsibility, remain calm under pressure, and prioritize effectively.

Flexibility is key: you'll start between 3:30 and 6:30 a.m. and work until everything is finished, OR you'll work in two shifts: from 3:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. and the other week from 1:30 p.m. to 10:30 p.m.

Working in a refrigerated environment? No problem for you!

 

Eager to get stuck in? Then you're the production worker we want on our team!

Where Italian nostalgia meets real hospitality leadership
 

Nando isn't just another restaurant, it's Nonna's kitchen, brought to life in Wilrijk, Antwerp. Retro details, honest Italian comfort food, and a room that feels like family. We're looking for a 
Waiter / Service Responsible to own the floor: someone who leads by example during service, keeps the room running like clockwork, and makes sure every guest leaves feeling like they just had dinner at home.
 

What you'll do
 
 

• Welcome guests and set the tone for the evening 

• Take orders and serve with precision, even when it's slammed 

• Own the floor during service — pace, table turns, team energy, guest happiness 

• Coach and steady the team in real time; step in and solve problems before guests notice them 

• Be the calm, capable presence management can count on when it gets busy  

What you bring
 
 

• Experience as a waiter or shift leader in hospitality 

• A natural feel for service and a bit of leadership instinct 

• Composure under pressure — busy nights don't rattle you 

• Organized, hands-on, solutions over excuses 

• English (required), basic Dutch (required); Italian or French is a real plus  

What's in it for you
 
 

• Full-time, 38h contract 

• €16.00–€18.00 brutto/hour, negotiable based on experience 

• Meal vouchers, holiday pay, and a 13th month 

• Bike allowance and uniform provided 

• Real responsibility on the floor from day one — with a clear path to become manager within your first 6 to 12 months 

• Room to grow within a restaurant group that's expanding  

Restaurant is open 7/7, with 2 days off per week.
 

 Send your CV, a photo, and a short intro to 
hr@lvpgroup.be — tell us why Nando feels like your kind of room.

Following comprehensive in-house training, you will work independently with a variety of sheet metal processing machines. You will manufacture and process metal components according to technical drawings and ensure a high-quality finish for every part.

Your responsibilities include:

• Operating and setting up various sheet metal processing machines.

• Performing cutting and bending operations based on technical drawings.

• Calculating flat patterns and preparing production parts.

• Processing metal components through bending, cutting, punching, tapping, and grinding.

• Performing semi-automatic welding when required.

• Inspecting finished products for quality and dimensional accuracy.

• Ensuring compliance with safety and quality procedures.

• You hold an A2 degree in Mechanics or have equivalent experience.

• You have experience with a guillotine shear, press brake, corner notching machine, and punching machine.

• You can read and accurately interpret technical drawings.

• You possess strong spatial awareness and technical insight.

• You work accurately, independently, and with a strong focus on quality.

• You follow safety and quality procedures diligently.

• Good knowledge of Dutch or English is sufficient.

Tasks:

- You have experience driving a forklift

As a Team Leader within the logistics department, you are responsible for leading and supporting a team of warehouse employees, with a focus on the efficient handling, storage, and distribution of goods. You ensure that operational targets are achieved and that safety and quality standards are consistently followed.

The role consists of four key areas of responsibility. In addition, you are willing to work operationally alongside your team when necessary.

 
• 
Team Leadership: Train, manage, motivate, and support your team to achieve operational targets, while identifying training and development needs.

 
• 
Operational Management: Monitor workflows related to the receipt, storage, picking, packing, and shipment of parts.

 
• 
Performance & Reporting: Monitor team performance and results and report these to the Supervisor.

 
• 
Problem Solving: Resolve minor operational issues and escalate more complex problems when necessary.

 
• 
Strong leadership and people management skills.

 
• 
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

 
• 
Excellent command of the English language.

 
• 
Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.

 
• 
Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

 
• 
Ability to work under pressure and adapt to changing priorities.

 
• 
Experience in warehouse management or a similar role, preferably within the automotive sector.

For our client in the food industry, located in the Oudenaarde region, we are looking for an Order Picker who is willing to work in a 3-shift system.

Your responsibilities 

 
• You collect products from the cold and hot production lines and store them in the correct location in the refrigerator. 
 
• You label products correctly and register batch numbers, expiry dates and returnable packaging in MAPA. 
 
• You monitor stock levels and report shortages in a timely manner. 
 
• You check incoming deliveries for quantity, temperature and condition, and register the information in MAPA. 
 
• You assist drivers with loading and unloading and correctly apply the FIFO principle. 
 
• You keep the warehouse, refrigerators and loading bays clean and tidy and ensure that returnable packaging is stored in the correct location. 
 
• You work an early, day or late shift – working hours vary depending on the schedule and the day. 

What are we looking for in an Order Picker?

 

 
• You have a good command of English. 
 
• You are comfortable working in a chilled environment of approximately 7°C. 
 
• You can operate an electric pallet truck and a reach truck. 
 
• You are flexible and available to work early, day and late shifts, including occasional Saturdays or Sundays. 
 
• You work accurately: quantities, temperatures, batch numbers and expiry dates must be correct. 
 
• You are able to maintain an overview when several orders need to be prepared at the same time and can determine which tasks should be given priority.
